summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings furnished Form 6-K disclosing a new technology strategy for UGV/UAV autonomy and a CTO transition. Foresight Automotive appointed Shlomo Hillel as CTO, while Levy Zruya resigned as Company CTO effective September 15, 2026. No financial terms, price, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The filing also notes incorporation by reference into existing F-3 and S-8 registration statements. An initial autonomous kit is targeted for customer evaluation in the first half of 2027. Watch execution risk around the abrupt CTO change and whether the expanded scope translates into commercial contracts.
